segments.text: I sleep whenever I want. I go to sleep at the same time every night because research shows that irregular sleep is just as bad for the body as not getting enough sleep. I scroll a little in bed. It helps me wind down. I turn all screens off 60 minutes before bed because they elevate stress and the blue light suppresses melatonin. I work late.

I eat late. That's just how it is when you grind. I don't eat anything within 4 hours of going to bed because it lowers my resting heart rate, which is the number one way to improve your sleep. I wake up. I check my notifications. I get light in my eyes as soon as I wake up because it sets my circadian rhythm and tells my body when to wake up and when to go to bed. I don't really exercise.
I'm just too busy with work. I work out at least 20 minutes a day because it measurably improves sleep quality. I'll sleep when I'm dead and I'm going to live forever. Yeah, well, at least
